title: Programming fundamentals: file handling
sub: Worksheet for the 360° experience: Filing room
objectives: know why a program needs to store data in a file
understand how a file is opened, read from, written to and closed
know the difference between writing to a file and appending to it
starter: A quiz game keeps a table of high scores. Explain what happens to those scores when the player closes the game, if the program stores them in variables only.
